evidence_tiers.A: Official Apple documentation: use for documented controls and behavior, not artistic prescriptions.
evidence_tiers.B: Retrieved specialist forum/expert practice: use as reviewed candidate strategy with context and limitations.
evidence_tiers.C: Community anecdote or broad discussion: use for phrasing, hypotheses, disagreements, and evaluation cases—not automatic truth.

review_states.candidate_not_yet_human_reviewed: May enter retrieval/evaluation only; cannot become exact instruction authority.
review_states.reviewed: A named reviewer has checked source fidelity, Logic version, safety, and wording.
review_states.rejected: Retained only if useful as a known bad pattern.
